## Common WHERE Filters

### 标准单日过滤（最常用）
```sql
WHERE
    tz_type = 'local'
    AND grass_region IN ('BR', 'ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN')
    AND grass_date = DATE '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
```

### 日期范围过滤
```sql
WHERE
    grass_date BETWEEN DATE '${start_dt}' AND DATE '${end_dt}'
    AND grass_region IN ('BR', 'ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN')
```

### 激励/宽表场景 (Budget + tROI + Boost)

```sql
    tz_type = 'local'
```


## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN 到 Campaign 级别 (最常用)
```sql
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        grass_date, grass_region, shop_id, campaign_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event IN (8) THEN event_id END) AS budget_operation_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event IN (50) THEN event_id END) AS troi_operation_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event IN (90, 91) THEN event_id END) AS boost_operation_cnt
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE
        tz_type = 'local'
        AND grass_region IN ('BR', 'ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN')
        AND grass_date = DATE '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
        AND audit_event IN (8, 50, 90, 91)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) campaign_audit
ON main.grass_date = campaign_audit.grass_date
   AND main.grass_region = campaign_audit.grass_region
   AND main.shop_id = campaign_audit.shop_id
   AND main.campaign_id = campaign_audit.campaign_id
```

### JOIN 到 Shop 级别 (聚合去 campaign)
```sql
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        grass_date, grass_region, shop_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event IN (8) THEN event_id END) AS budget_operation_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event IN (50) THEN event_id END) AS troi_operation_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event IN (90, 91) THEN event_id END) AS boost_operation_cnt
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local'
        AND grass_region IN ('BR', 'ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN')
        AND grass_date = DATE '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
        AND audit_event IN (8, 50, 90, 91)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
) campaign_audit
ON main.grass_date = campaign_audit.grass_date
   AND main.grass_region = campaign_audit.grass_region
   AND main.shop_id = campaign_audit.shop_id
```

### JOIN 到 Hourly 粒度 (按小时对齐)
```sql
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        grass_date, grass_region, campaign_id,
        FORMAT_DATETIME(CAST(event_datetime AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH') AS formatted_datetime,
        MAX(roi_two_target_value_new) AS roi_two_target_value_new,
        MIN(roi_two_target_value_old) AS roi_two_target_value_old,
        COUNT(1) AS event_num
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE audit_event = 50
        AND grass_date = DATE '${regional_date}'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) hourly_stats
ON search.campaign_id = hourly_stats.campaign_id
   AND search.regional_date = hourly_stats.grass_date
   AND search.grass_region = hourly_stats.grass_region
   AND search.formatted_datetime = hourly_stats.formatted_datetime
```

### 展开到 Ads 粒度 (Index Status)
```sql
-- campaign_audit 在 campaign 粒度，通过 dim_advertise 展开到 ads 粒度
campaign_audit_df AS (
    SELECT
        campaign_id, audit_event, event_timestamp,
        grass_region, grass_date,
        roi_two_target_value_old, roi_two_target_value_new,
        get_json_object(old_data, '$.daily_quota') / 100000 AS old_budget,
        get_json_object(new_data, '$.daily_quota') / 100000 AS new_budget
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = '${grass_date}'
        AND audit_event IN (1, 2, 8, 50)
)
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ads_id, item_id, shop_id, campaign_id, grass_date, grass_region
    FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
    WHERE is_ads_active = 1 AND grass_date = '${grass_date}'
) dim ON campaign_audit_df.campaign_id = dim.campaign_id
    AND campaign_audit_df.grass_date = dim.grass_date
    AND campaign_audit_df.grass_region = dim.grass_region
WHERE campaign_audit_df.audit_event IN (8, 50)
```

```sql
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
```

### 暂停/停止标识 (30天窗口)
```sql

    campaign_id, grass_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN audit_event IN (1, 9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_pause,
    MAX(CASE WHEN audit_event = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_stop
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
    AND grass_region = UPPER('${grass_region}')
    AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 30) AND DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
    AND audit_event IN (1, 5, 9)
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### ROI 变化方向 (Increase/Decrease)
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT grass_date, grass_region, shop_id, campaign_id,
    CASE
        WHEN roi_two_target_value_old > roi_two_target_value_new THEN 'decrease'
        WHEN roi_two_target_value_old < roi_two_target_value_new
             AND roi_two_target_value_old < roi_two_target_value_new * 0.7
             THEN 'increase to 0.7 * new troi > old troi'
        WHEN roi_two_target_value_old < roi_two_target_value_new THEN 'increase others'
    END AS target_direction,
    roi_two_target_value_new - roi_two_target_value_old AS target_change
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE audit_event = 50
    AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-18' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
    AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
    AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### 预算变化方向
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT grass_date, grass_region, shop_id, campaign_id,
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(old_data, '$.daily_quota') AS DOUBLE)
             > CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(new_data, '$.daily_quota') AS DOUBLE)
             THEN 'decrease'
        WHEN CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(old_data, '$.daily_quota') AS DOUBLE)
             < CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(new_data, '$.daily_quota') AS DOUBLE)
             THEN 'increase'
    END AS budget_direction
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE audit_event = 8
    AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-18' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
    AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
    AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Snippet 2: LTV Monitor - Seller Ops Detection
```sql
ops AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, shop_id
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 6) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
        AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
        AND operator NOT LIKE 'System'
)
SELECT
    p.shop_id,
    GREATEST(0, pred_ltv) AS pred_ltv,
    COALESCE(actual.actual_spend, 0) AS actual_ltv,
    CASE WHEN o.shop_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS have_seller_ops
FROM actual
JOIN pred p ON p.grass_region = actual.grass_region AND p.shop_id = actual.shop_id
LEFT JOIN ops o ON o.grass_region = actual.grass_region AND o.shop_id = actual.shop_id
```

### Snippet 3: Search Hourly Bid Monitoring (join with audit)
```sql
hourly_stats AS (
    SELECT
        grass_date, grass_region, campaign_id,
        FORMAT_DATETIME(CAST(event_datetime AS TIMESTAMP), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH') AS formatted_datetime,
        MAX(roi_two_target_value_new) AS roi_two_target_value_new,
        MIN(roi_two_target_value_old) AS roi_two_target_value_old,
        COUNT(1) AS event_num
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE audit_event = 50
        AND grass_date = DATE '${regional_date}'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT
    search.campaign_id,
    search.total_bid / exchange.exchange_rate AS total_bid_usd,
    hourly_stats.roi_two_target_value_new,
    hourly_stats.roi_two_target_value_old,
    hourly_stats.event_num AS hourly_event_num
FROM search
LEFT JOIN hourly_stats
    ON search.campaign_id = hourly_stats.campaign_id
    AND search.regional_date = hourly_stats.grass_date
    AND search.grass_region = hourly_stats.grass_region
    AND search.formatted_datetime = hourly_stats.formatted_datetime
```

### Snippet 6: PySpark - Audit Event Value Extraction
```python
audit_df = spark.table(audit_table_incr).filter(
    (col('tz_type') == 'local') &
    (col('grass_date') == args.dt) &
    (col('grass_region').isin(regions)) &
    (col('audit_event').isin([8, 50, 90, 91]))
).select(
    'audit_event', 'event_id', 'event_datetime',
    when(col('audit_event') == 8, 'budget')
        .when(col('audit_event').isin(90, 91), 'rapid_boost_toggle')
        .otherwise('target_roi').alias('operate_type'),
    'shop_id', 'campaign_id',
    when(col('audit_event') == 50, col('roi_two_target_value_old'))
        .when(col('audit_event') == 8, get_json_object(col('old_data'), '$.daily_quota'))
        .when(col('audit_event') == 90, 0)
        .when(col('audit_event') == 91, 1).alias('value_before'),
    when(col('audit_event') == 50, col('roi_two_target_value_new'))
        .when(col('audit_event') == 8, get_json_object(col('new_data'), '$.daily_quota'))
        .when(col('audit_event') == 90, 1)
        .when(col('audit_event') == 91, 0).alias('value_after'),
)
```

```sql
audit_budget_log AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region, shop_id, campaign_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN
            (grass_region = 'BR' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 6.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            OR (grass_region = 'ID' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 5000.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            OR (grass_region = 'MY' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 4.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            OR (grass_region = 'PH' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 40.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            OR (grass_region = 'SG' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 4.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            OR (grass_region = 'TH' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 40.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            OR (grass_region = 'TW' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 40.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            OR (grass_region = 'VN' AND campaign_daily_quota_local < 10000.000 * 100000 AND campaign_daily_quota_local > 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS audit_low_budget_times
    FROM (
        SELECT
            grass_region, shop_id, campaign_id,
            CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(new_data, '$.daily_quota') AS bigint) AS campaign_daily_quota_local
        FROM mp_paidads.dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
        WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
            AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
            AND audit_event IN (4, 49, 8, 63, 64)
    )
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
-- Then LEFT JOIN with dim_campaign to add dim_low_budget_times
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

**生产 Pipeline**: `data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse/dwd/setup/dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live/`
- 写入方式: `INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ... PARTITION (tz_type='local', grass_region, grass_date)`
- 调度频率: Daily (per region)
- 分区策略: Dynamic partition by region, 每天覆盖写入当天的 tz_type='local' 分区

**上游表**:
| 上游表 | 数据库 | 说明 |
|--------|--------|------|
| `shopee_ads_${region}_ultimate_shard_db__campaign_audit_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live` | mp_paidads | Campaign audit CDC (主表) |
| `shopee_ads_${region}_ultimate_shard_db__product_campaign_audit_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live` | mp_paidads | Product campaign audit CDC |
| `shopee_ads_${region}_ultimate_shard_db__ad_audit_event_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live` | mp_paidads | Ad audit event CDC |

**数据加工逻辑**:
1. **Campaign 数据合并** (campaign_audit view): `UNION ALL` 两张 campaign audit 表（general + product campaign），用 protobuf UDF 解码 extinfo
2. **Ad Audit Event** (ad_audit_event view): 从 ad_audit_event_tab 读取事件元信息（operator、platform、event_timestamp）
3. **LEFT JOIN 合并**: `campaign_audit LEFT JOIN ad_audit_event ON event_id`
4. **ROI 值转换**: 所有 ROI/budget 字段从源表 bigint (x100000) 除以 100000.0 转为 double
5. **UDF 函数**:
   - `CampaignAuditDecodeProtoBuf` — 解码 campaign audit extinfo
   - `ProductCampaignAuditDecodeProtoBuf` — 解码 product campaign audit extinfo

**简化的写入逻辑**:
```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dwd_campaign_audit_di__reg_s0_live
PARTITION (tz_type='local', grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT
    a.id, a.event_id, a.campaign_id, a.user_id, a.shop_id,
    a.status AS campaign_status, b.audit_event,
    a.target_broad_roi / 100000.0 AS target_broad_roi,
    b.operator, b.operator_id, b.platform,
    b.event_timestamp, b.event_datetime,
    a.old_data, a.new_data,
    roi_two_target_value_old / 100000.0,
    roi_two_target_value_new / 100000.0,
    b.current_target_roi / 100000.0,
    b.last1_day_target_roi / 100000,
    b.last7_day_target_roi / 100000,
    a.new_data_extinfo, a.old_data_extinfo,
    b.ad_audit_event_extinfo,
    UPPER('${region}') AS grass_region,
    DATE('${grass_date}') AS grass_date
FROM campaign_audit a
LEFT JOIN ad_audit_event b ON a.event_id = b.event_id
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下派生指标在 2+ 个文件中重复出现：

| Metric | Formula | Source Event |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| budget_operation_cnt | COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event=8 THEN event_id END) | audit_event=8 |
| troi_operation_cnt | COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event=50 THEN event_id END) | audit_event=50 |
| boost_operation_cnt | COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN audit_event IN (90,91) THEN event_id END) | audit_event=90,91 |
| pause_ads_cnt_1d | SUM(IF(audit_event IN (1,9), 1, 0)) | audit_event=1,9 |
| stop_ads_cnt_1d | SUM(IF(audit_event=5, 1, 0)) | audit_event=5 |
| has_pause | MAX(CASE WHEN audit_event IN (1,9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) | audit_event=1,9 |
| has_stop | MAX(CASE WHEN audit_event=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) | audit_event=5 |
| have_seller_ops | CASE WHEN shop_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END | operator NOT LIKE 'System' |
| target_direction | CASE roi_two_target_value_old >/< roi_two_target_value_new | audit_event=50 |
| budget_direction | CASE old_data.daily_quota >/< new_data.daily_quota | audit_event=8 |
| value_before | roi_two_target_value_old / old_data.daily_quota / 0(boost_on) / 1(boost_off) | audit_event=8/50/90/91 |
| value_after | roi_two_target_value_new / new_data.daily_quota / 1(boost_on) / 0(boost_off) | audit_event=8/50/90/91 |
| operate_type | 'budget' / 'target_roi' / 'rapid_boost_toggle' | audit_event=8/50/90-91 |
| audit_low_budget_times | SUM(CASE WHEN budget < region_min_budget THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) | audit_event IN (4,49,8,63,64) |
| campaign_start_end_cnt | COUNT(1) | audit_event IN (1,5) then self-join on resume events |
| campaign_budget_change_cnt | COUNT(1) | audit_event=8 |
